newsitem.title: UK: NWE jet fuel cargoes tight, hit by lack of shippin.
newsitem.headline: NWE jet fuel cargoes tight, hit by lack of shippin.

text.p: The NWE jet fuel cargo market was tight and remained restricted by lack of shipping and barge demand was modest amid inactive business on Monday, traders said.
Feb IPE gas oil futures closed down $6.75 at $209 a tonne on warmer European weather.

Cif cargoes NWE were unchanged around Feb IPE +$33/34. NWE barges were notionally around Feb +$30/31 fob ARA. Buying interest is mainly into Scandinavia. British refinery supply is tight and focussed on domestic demand.
